name: Drag
summary: In Orgrimmar, the Drag draws traders and craftspeople between three valleys. Its shaded red-rock canyon also descends to the Cleft of Shadow.

sections.title: The Artisan's Thoroughfare
sections.body: The Drag runs between Orgrimmar’s red canyon walls, filled with crafters and traders. Unlike the Valley of Strength, where soldiers muster and receive commands, this is where daily city life unfolds. High cliffs and hides shade the street. Tanning vats, alchemical cauldrons and tinkers’ gears fill it with sound and smell. Craftsmen practice their trades and teach aspiring adventurers, from leatherworkers and tailors to the goblins at Nogg’s Machine Shop.

sections.title: A Crossroads of Shadows and Craft
sections.body: Merchant storefronts and salvage houses line the Drag beside the guarded entrance to the underground Cleft of Shadow. Honest tradesmen share the street with shamans bound for the Valley of Wisdom and practitioners of dark arts. Beneath the canyon’s dim, dusty overhangs, their paths cross.

faq.q: What is the Drag used for in Orgrimmar?
aliases: what shops are in the drag
faq.answer: The Drag is Orgrimmar’s main district for shopping and trade. Trainers and supply vendors serve professions such as alchemy, tailoring, leatherworking, skinning, enchanting and engineering, alongside general salvage and trade goods.

aliases: how to get to cleft of shadow
faq.answer: The Drag links the Valley of Strength in the south to the Valley of Honor in the northeast, with paths toward the Valley of Wisdom. The entrance to the shadowy caverns of the Cleft of Shadow lies along the western cliffside.
Nogg is a goblin engineer who runs Nogg’s Machine Shop along the Drag. He trains engineers and supplies gadgets to members of the Horde.

faq.q: Are all profession trainers located in the Drag?
faq.answer: Most crafting and gathering professions have shops along the Drag’s lower and upper shelves. The city’s blacksmiths and miners work in the fiery forges of the Valley of Honor.

angles.text: In the Drag, goblin tinkerers at Nogg’s Machine Shop teach schematics, explosives and specialized engineering knowledge to the Horde.
As you travel through Orgrimmar, you pass along the Drag, linking the capital’s martial heart to its communal and mystical quarters.
